_comment: RelayVSR video super-resolution (core comfy_extras.nodes_wan). RelayVSRConditioning takes the low-quality frames at native size and hands the sampler its conditioning and latent; it has only link inputs, so it runs as-is. VSR Decode decodes the sampled latent against those same frames, and its `detail` sets how much of the model's added detail over a bicubic upscale is kept (1 = full model output).
